title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 7 — WORLD 2: ADVANCED COMMUNICATION CORE
description: World 2 strengthens advanced communication through discourse control, argumentation, nuanced vocabulary, authentic listening and extended written and spoken production.

targets.vocabulary: 2700+ active words and phrases with collocations, idioms and academic-functional language
targets.reading: 1700–2000 word texts with synthesis, evaluation and inference
targets.listening: 17–20 minutes of authentic conversations, interviews and discussions
targets.speaking: 22–27 minutes of sustained interaction, debate and explanation
targets.writing: 600–750 words across argument, analysis and formal communication
